Simulate UNO Turn-by-Turn Gameplay

play_turns_loop.Rd

Runs the main loop of a UNO game where each player takes a turn until one wins or the draw pile is exhausted. Handles matching, drawing, and playing cards with full support for action and wild card effects.

Usage

play_turns_loop(hands, deck, discard, direction, turn)

Arguments

hands

A named list of tibbles (one per player), with each tibble containing columns color, value, and type.

deck

A tibble representing the draw pile.

discard

A tibble representing the discard pile.

direction

Integer: 1 = clockwise, -1 = counter-clockwise.

turn

Integer (1-based): index of the current player.

Value

A named list:

  • winner – Character string (e.g., "Player_2"), or NULL if deck runs out

  • hands – Final state of each player's hand (winner has 0 cards)

  • discard – Final discard pile including the last played card

Details

- Handles special cards: "skip", "reverse", "+2", "wild", "wild_draw4"
- If no playable card, player draws one from the draw pile
- Wilds automatically assign a random color after play
- If the deck is exhausted, the game ends with no winner (to be improved)

Note: In a future version, deck reshuffling and wild color choice prompts will be added to make the simulation more robust.

Examples

state <- setup_game(4)
play_turns_loop(
  hands = state$hands,
  deck = state$deck,
  discard = state$discard,
  direction = state$direction,
  turn = state$turn
)
#> $winner
#> [1] "Player_3"
#> 
#> $hands
#> $hands$Player_1

#>   color value      type

#> 2 wild  wild_draw4 wild

#> 4 blue  4          number
#> 5 wild  wild       wild
